title: Gene-set Functional Analysis
description: Map a bounded human gene set, then review Reactome pathway overrepresentation and STRING functional associations through a researcher-approved workflow.

tools.name: functional_analysis_preflight
tools.description: Map two to fifty human gene or protein identifiers to STRING and preview the approved Reactome/STRING analysis parameters without persisting results.

genes.description: Two to fifty unique human gene symbols, Ensembl IDs, UniProt accessions, or STRING-recognized identifiers.

tools.name: functional_analysis_run
tools.description: Execute and persist an approved human gene-set review using Reactome overrepresentation, STRING enrichment, functional network edges, PPI enrichment, and provenance files.
